name: Urban Planning Paradigm
consequences: Shifting from a sprawling metropolis to a more compact, walkable cityscape reduces the game's open-world feel and may alienate fans of previous GTA titles.
options: Implement a 'hub-and-spoke' design, where central districts serve as hubs for various activities, reducing travel time and increasing NPC density.
Incorporate verticality through high-rise buildings and rooftop spaces, allowing players to explore multiple levels within a single area.
Utilize a 'mosaic' approach, dividing the city into smaller, interconnected neighborhoods with distinct cultural and architectural identities.
review: Implementing a hub-and-spoke design would introduce trade-offs between open-world exploration and condensed urban planning, leaving unaddressed the impact on procedural generation and narrative immersion.
